QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Juliet is Impressed
QuestInfo.0: Juliet seemed very much in love with Romeo after receiving the letter, which meant one thing. Juliet wants to repay the love with a present of her own. I better go see #bJuliet#k.
QuestInfo.1: Juliet decided the best way to respond to the letter was to cook for him by making a lunchbox. ...A lunchbox by an alchemist from Alcadno... I better help her make one before Juliet poisons Romeo to death with her toxic cooking skills. I better buy the #blunchbox recipe#k from #bHan the Broker#k. \n\n#i4031785##t4031785# #b#c4031785##k/1
QuestInfo.2: I handed Juliet Han the Broker's recipe for lunchbox.

0.0: Hello traveler! What do you think Romeo likes more, Stir-Fried Scorpion Tail or Seasoned Bellamoa? Ahh, it might be a little far from here, but how about a Poison Popper Stew? What do you think?\r\n#b#L0# I almost threw up.  Please tell me you're not thinking about serving that to your boyfriend!#l
0.1: Why, yes!  I just received a letter from Romeo. I can't just sit here and do nothing, so I decided to make a delicious, special dish for the love of my life. Don't you think he'll love it if I make an exotic lunch for him? \r\n#b#L0#...If he lives after eating it...#l
0.2: I've never cooked before, can you tell?  But I've also made some clothes, this can't be that much different. I just don't know what kind of food he'll like, though... what do you think?\r\n#b#L0# How about a plain dish?  Something that won't make him break up with you?#l
0.3: A plain dish? Well... maybe a plain dish that's delicious can be more special than anything else! Well, in that case, can you please help me?  I want to make this lunch special!

yes.0: There's only one place in Magatia that you can get a recipe for delicious food, through #bHan the Broker#k. He also has items that have nothing to do with alchemy, so please get a #blunchbox recipe#k from him.

no.0: Hmm... you must be really busy right now. Maybe I should try #rDark Wyvern Wing Stew#k...

1.0: Ah, you purchased a recipe from Han the Broker. Thank you so much! I'll have to start making the lunchbox out of this right this minute... with all my heart for Romeo.

item.0: I don't think you have gotten the #blunchbox recipe#k yet. The only person in Magatia that sells the recipes is #bHan the Broker#k, so please ask him.
